title: Oil Giant Saudi Aramco Reports 33% Profit Surge, Despite Iran War Disruptions
summary: Higher oil prices propelled a quarterly earnings jump for Saudi Arabia’s energy giant, which used pipelines to work around disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
